articles.headline: OpenAI adds GPT‑5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna – now reachable via Amazon Bedrock
articles.dek: The new GPT‑5.6 model family is live, integrated with Bedrock, priced like OpenAI’s API, and each model targets a distinct workload.

body.text: Key Takeaway

Three GPT‑5.6 models—Sol, Terra, and Luna—are now live [FACT:f00ca8ce4571b00200e6b1dc59b260eb], and Amazon Bedrock lets you launch any of them using the standard OpenAI API keys [FACT:518b7f136e85acf1a51a8182552eaefa] at the same rates OpenAI publishes for its own service [FACT:99dfdac39f8e02db02d83953c863f9cd].
Why This Matters

Sol is tuned for low‑latency, high‑throughput prompts; Terra is the flagship reasoning engine that balances accuracy and speed [FACT:a10d1ea3131c5c5edc5946684eb68043]; and Luna is positioned for autonomous coding workloads across regions [FACT:ea69183969945d3c3d6b8f61af5fd31b].
What Happened

OpenAI announced the suite in a blog post authored by Chris Dickens [FACT:c7ad6ebd010ef06b07244289a5b57701], which also walks you through selecting the desired model name in your Bedrock request [FACT:45edd10060b5a05e0a56492d5fcb5f1e].
Builder View

If you already run coding agents on Bedrock, swapping the model identifier to “luna‑v1” lets you tap the autonomous‑coding engine without changing your budget, thanks to identical pricing [FACT:99dfdac39f8e02db02d83953c863f9cd] and the same access path [FACT:518b7f136e85acf1a51a8182552eaefa].
Open Questions
Benchmarks for latency and accuracy at production scale are still pending, and developers are only beginning to explore long‑horizon agentic coding use cases [FACT:021bb0a44cfac295c1cb2b7bbe38ed12].
Ardur Take

Bottom line: the GPT‑5.6 trio is production‑ready on Bedrock, costs match OpenAI’s public pricing, and you can try them by updating the model ARN—just treat performance claims as provisional until you run your own tests [FACT:f00ca8ce4571b00200e6b1dc59b260eb][FACT:99dfdac39f8e02db02d83953c863f9cd][FACT:518b7f136e85acf1a51a8182552eaefa].

keyPoints: Sol, Terra, and Luna are available as GPT‑5.6 models on Bedrock [FACT:f00ca8ce4571b00200e6b1dc59b260eb]
Pricing mirrors OpenAI’s first‑party rates, so no surprise cost spikes [FACT:99dfdac39f8e02db02d83953c863f9cd]
Luna targets autonomous coding; Terra is the flagship reasoning model; Sol focuses on low‑latency workloads [FACT:ea69183969945d3c3d6b8f61af5fd31b][FACT:a10d1ea3131c5c5edc5946684eb68043]
articles.whyItMatters: This matters for AI + LLMs practitioners — AWS Machine Learning Blog covered the implications worth tracking.
articles.readerAction: Open the AWS Machine Learning Blog post, note the model identifiers (sol‑v1, terra‑v1, luna‑v1), and update your Bedrock SDK call or console configuration accordingly; the same OpenAI API key you already use will work [FACT:45edd10060b5a05e0a56492d5fcb5f1e][FACT:518b7f136e85acf1a51a8182552eaefa].
